neighborhoods: National hotline (use from anywhere, any hour)
notes:
(888) 426-4435 - aspca.org/pet-care/animal-poison-control - if an animal has been poisoned or exposed to a toxin. Staffed 24/7, 365 days a year.

(888) 426-4435 - 24/7, vet toxicologists. Consult fee ~$95 (waived w/ HomeAgain microchip).

(888) 426-4435 - 24/7 (a consultation fee may apply). aspca.org/pet-care/animal-poison-control.

THE call for a suspected poisoning/toxin ingestion (lilies, meds, antifreeze, rodenticide, etc.) - staffed 24/7 by vet toxicologists who guide you AND your ER vet with a treatment plan. Lilies are deadly to cats even in tiny amounts. Then go to a 24hr ER (see Emergency tab). Verified 2026-08-26. Intake: Call 24/7/365. If a cat ate/contacted something toxic, call BEFORE inducing anything. Other channel: Consultation fee may apply (~$95; waived w/ HomeAgain-enrolled microchip)
